source: Fields side panel > Create new, list level, Free Forever, 2026-10-16

sections.AI Suggestions: 4 suggestions generated from the list name (2 AI text fields, 1 dropdown, 1 website); content varies per list

descriptions_excerpt.Dropdown: single select options for departments or categorization
descriptions_excerpt.Date: dates that are not the due date; shown on the Calendar view
descriptions_excerpt.Checkbox: yes or no; can trigger automations
descriptions_excerpt.People: people who are not the assignee (RACI, requesters)
